one_line_description: Manage commerce features of Squarespace merchant sites
auth_methods_evidence: Authentication for Commerce APIs also provides permissions to keep Squarespace merchant site data private and secure.
self_serve_evidence:
Become familiar with commerce terms and how they're related to the APIs
Learn how to send authenticated requests
Read the FAQ for answers to common questions
buildability_rationale: Good documentation and REST API with OAuth2, but limited endpoint information and no Composio support.
agent_notes: The documentation provides a good overview of the Commerce APIs but doesn't specify the exact number of endpoints. The API uses REST principles and supports webhooks.
